decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design & Access Statement, Location Plan Received 28/03/2011 and 0781.1 Rev A Received 21/06/2011 and Parking Assessment Received 21/07/2011) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No deliveries shall be taken at, or dispatched from, the site between the hours of 7am-9am and 4pm-7pm

Condition : 4 - All deliveries shall be taken away from Transport for London Road Network (TLRN) or within existing parking or loading bays on the TLRN. All vehicles (including powered two wheelers) associated with the proposed Hot food takeaway shall not be driven or be parked on any part of the TLRN footway at any time and only parked on the carriageway where existing restrictions apply.
Condition : 5 - The ventilation system when operating at its maximum level shall be 10dB(A) below existing background noise levels and shall be mounted on anti-vibration mountings.

Condition : 6 - The extract system hereby approved shall comprise of a three-stage system to include a grease, pre-carbon and carbon filter. The duct as shown on the approved plans, shall terminate one metre above the eaves or one metre above any openable windows of adjacent premises whichever is the higher. The duct shall terminate pointing upwards. A cowl shall be omitted and lightweight flaps or other covers, which open when the system is powered, should be fitted. The system shall be routinely serviced and maintained.
Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 12 midday to midnight on Monday till Saturday and 12 midday until 10pm on Sunday.
description: Change of use to A5 (Hot Food Takeaway) and the installation of an extractor flue to the rear of the premises.
